Title: Public Preview: SQL Formatter in MSSQL extension

Body.Content:
With SQL Formatter, you can format SQL scripts directly in your editor for cleaner, more consistent, and readable code. Now in public preview, it includes more customizable formatting options to match your preferred coding style and streamline development. 
 
Learn more.
